svg.title: pi Men c: the stored light curve, the reviewers' marks and the limb-darkened fit
svg.desc: pi Men c in TESS sector 1, from SetuHQ's stored run. Left: the stored light curve of pi Men (TIC 261136679), 3,485 points in 10-minute bins over BTJD 1325.3 to 1351.3, in parts per million, with the 7 consensus dips: 5 passed and on pi Men c's published ephemeris (known, at BTJD 1325.50, 1331.77, 1338.05, 1344.27, 1350.57), 1 passed but off the ephemeris and flagged (open, at BTJD 1348.94), and 1 rejected by vetting (at BTJD 1348.38). Below it, each reviewer's marks as stored: Probe · Sensitive 8; Probe · Typical 8; Probe · Cautious 8; Sentinel · Volunteer 5; Sentinel · Skeptic 5 spans. Right: the points folded on the joint limb-darkened fit of the five epochs (period 6.2680 d), from 5 hours before to 5 hours after mid-transit, with 20-minute means and the fitted model integrated over the 10-minute bins. Rp/R★ = 0.0179 ± 0.0017, 1.05 times Huang et al. 2018's 0.01703; T14 = 3.07 ± 0.17 h, 1.04 times Huang's 2.953 h; model depth 292 ± 8 ppm. A known planet recovered, not a discovery. Sources: runs/tess-pi-men-s1 (subjects, classifications.csv, candidates.json) and docs/results/pi_men_validation.json, commit b742c73.
